notes: Checked against the oracle's FallHangProbe dump. Also called from dev.c and serverreplay.c (tape replay uses fh_adopt_falling and fh_tick_one). Drops are recorded via fh_env.drop and never joined to a list. Not ported: the TileEntityData placement path (no ITileEntityProvider falling block in 1.7.10), hanging-entity damage from players or projectiles (onBroken is always called with a null entity), item-frame interaction (rotate or insert by right click). Anvils fall only via the dev/probe paths since redstone is off does not matter here; anvil use itself is switched off in world.conf but the block still falls. lane/pick: fh_tick_one removes an entity killed outside its own update without updating it; a drop carries its Det Random state; fallhang_player_break and fh_entities_in_box serve the pick and the projectile lists. lane/envmem: fh_chunk_drop_empty drops an unloaded chunk's empty lists (the park).
